Vance, Oz Probe Obamacare Subsidies, Affecting Thousands

US Senators JD Vance and John Fetterman are investigating alleged fraud in the enrollment process for Obamacare subsidies, which could impact "thousands" of enrollees. Forbes reported that "Obamacare stocks" were affected after Vance claimed "750,000 enrolled via fraud." USA Today also reported on the probe, stating it "cuts off subsidies to thousands of Obamacare enrollees."
